components.name: Apache Zookeeper
components.description: Apache ZooKeeper is a distributed coordination service designed to manage and synchronize large-scale distributed systems.

components.name: Apache Kafka
components.description: Apache Kafka is a high-throughput, distributed messaging system designed for real-time data streaming and processing.

components.name: Flink on Yarn
components.description: Running Apache Flink on YARN (Yet Another Resource Negotiator) involves deploying and managing Flink jobs in a Hadoop ecosystem.

components.name: Apache HBase
components.description: Apache HBase is a distributed, scalable, NoSQL database built on top of the Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS).

components.name: ClickHouse
components.description: ClickHouse is an open-source, columnar database management system designed for real-time analytical processing of large volumes of data.

components.name: Apache Druid
components.description: Apache Druid is a high-performance, real-time analytics database designed for fast, interactive queries on large-scale data.

components.name: Nacos
components.description: Nacos (Naming and Configuration Service) is an open-source platform designed for dynamic service discovery, configuration management, and service management in microservices architectures.

components.name: HOS
components.description: HOS is a distributed object storage service designed for storing and managing large volumes of unstructured data.

components.name: XXL-JOB
components.description: XXL-JOB is a distributed task scheduling platform designed for managing and executing batch jobs in a distributed environment.

components.name: MariaDB
components.description: MariaDB is an open-source relational database management system designed for high-performance, scalable, and secure data storage.

components.name: ArangoDB
components.description: ArangoDB is a graph database management system designed for storing, querying, and analyzing graph data.
